subject: Chemistry
b6_reason: B (electron mass), C (isotopes share chemical properties), and E (Dalton's atom as ultimate particle) are true; A is false (atom has three fundamental particles, not two) and D is false (nucleons are protons+neutrons, not protons+electrons).
